record: Written before opening confirmatory outcomes. Eight additional disjoint 16-probe panels (April hash order positions 160..287), four new calendar windows Sep/Oct/Nov/Dec 2025, same four measured destinations. 24 draws each. Main regime, quotas, independent schedules, primary budget policy and LP bound as in study_plan.
primary_repeat: Original joint policy from April calibration, confirm again lower 95% panel CI >10 over the exact prebooking upper bound. Quote full range and number of positive panels.
interaction: Hold all tuning and paid feedback constant. Cross actual present roster vs hidden with full local dual prices vs zero prices (with identical hard resource caps in all cells). Difference-in-differences quantifies superadditivity. Secondary comparison with only the price of duplicate reservations.
additional: Study opportunity prices estimated from simulated uniform future rosters (no reward/model update from hypothetical samples). The extension was motivated by first evaluation; parameters fit only on April (lookahead_dev.json), formal replication on the second sample. Compare rolling historical roster forecast, greedy without UCB, recency, LP and empirical filter. No claim of distinct UCB superiority unless +5 with lower CI against strongest control. Same trusted roster from other source is decision-equivalent.
uncertainty: 10,000 paired resamples of the eight panels; rng 734128. Monte Carlo draws averaged within panel, all reachability observations shared across paired controllers. Conditional on dates and destinations. No WAN or production consensus-throughput claim.
